defect_location.description: CVE-2015-0206: dtls1_buffer_record 为 next epoch 缓冲重复记录时 memory leak（CVE 描述: Memory leak in dtls1_buffer_record ... by sending many duplicate records for the next epoch）→ 攻击者可耗尽内存。LeakSanitizer 捕获。

source.simplification: 剥离 DTLS 网络层，epoch 判定用参数硬编码，保留『为下一 epoch 缓冲记录时错误路径不释放 rdata』核心缺陷

trigger_condition: 重复收到下一 epoch 的重复记录（8 次），每次缓冲路径都走错误返回
notes: CVE-2015-0206: dtls1_buffer_record 为 next epoch 缓冲重复记录时 memory leak（CVE 描述: Memory leak in dtls1_buffer_record ... by sending many duplicate records for the next epoch）→ 攻击者可耗尽内存。LeakSanitizer 捕获。
